# Calculate Wassenstein distance for d = 30

```{r}
etas = 30 # scaled by n = 10000

outer_loop_ind = readRDS(file =  paste("experiments/d30/eta", etas,"rho096m2500_outer.RDS", sep = ""))
benchmark = readRDS(file =  paste("experiments/d30/MH_primals.RDS", sep = ""))
two_loop = readRDS(file =  paste("experiments/d30/eta", etas,"rho096m2500_allx.RDS", sep = ""))

X <- t(as.matrix(benchmark))[1:outer_loop_ind[135],]
X <- X[-(1:10000),]
Y <- t(as.matrix(two_loop))

Ws = numeric(135)
for(j in 1:135){
Ysmall = Y[1:outer_loop_ind[j], , drop = FALSE]
  W <- T4transport::swdist(X,Ysmall,p = 2,nproj = 100)
  Ws[j] = W$distance
  print(j)
}
saveRDS(Ws, file = paste("experiments/d30/W2_sFO_MLA_eta", etas,".RDS", sep = ""))

abbr = c("001", "01", "30")
for(k in 1:3){
  Ws[2:135] = numeric(134)
  Z = t(readRDS(file =  paste("experiments/d30/eta", abbr[k], "_allx.RDS", sep = "")))
  Z = Z[1:outer_loop_ind[135],]
  for(j in 2:135){
  Zsmall = Z[1:outer_loop_ind, , drop = F]
    W <- T4transport::swdist(X,Zsmall,p = 2,nproj = 100)
    Ws[j] = W$distance
    print(j)
  }
  saveRDS(Ws, file = paste("experiments/d30/W2_eta", abbr[k], ".RDS", sep = ""))
}
```
